# Template — Label and column mapping (`.maestra/labels.md`)

> Source: round R12 (issue #44) + ADR-002 · Module version: 1 — 2026-08-06
> Anti-drift: separate from `config.md` by design — the config parser (ADR-014) accepts only 4 keys and silently ignores the rest; this file carries the label/column convention. Platform-neutral (ADR-012): values are repo-specific names; the platform's column model (board field options × column labels) is resolved via the cookbook.

```markdown
# Label and column mapping

<!-- ADR-002: generated by the setup journey (J12); edit by hand to remap. -->

- stage-1-label: {label marking Stage 1 work — proposed default: Produto}
- stage-2-label: {label marking Stage 2 work — proposed default: Engenharia}
- stage-3-label: {label marking Stage 3 work — proposed default: Entrega}
- column-not-started: {board column for not-yet-started work}
- column-in-progress: {board column for active work}
- column-in-review: {board column for work awaiting review/reconciliation}
- column-delivered: {board column for closed, reconciled work}
```

**Rules:**
- Born in the setup journey (J12 STAGE 1): the facilitator proposes the defaults (`Produto`/`Engenharia`/`Entrega` for stages), the human confirms or renames; missing labels are created on the platform in the same act (`create-label` operation of the cookbook — idempotent).
- **Convention, not cache:** column names are always re-derived from the REAL board when operating (P6); this file records the human-confirmed naming convention, and on divergence the board wins and the file is corrected in the act.
- Remap = partial J12 invocation ("reconfigura as labels") or manual edit — one file, one place.
- Versioned in the repository ("no state outside the repository").
